purpose: Custom game map database design. This is an independent planning dataset; existing V0.5.43 maps and gameplay are unchanged.
principles: Original L1J map IDs and coordinates are archival references, not custom game coordinates.
Custom map IDs remain stable even when art/layout changes.
Monster templates use original Taiwan L1J npcId; placement/spawn is separate from monster stats.
Respawn timing, positions, quantities, boundaries, entrances and exits are pending map design and must not be fabricated.
Client presentation and server authoritative spawn state must remain separate.

worldArchitecture.name: 多張獨立地圖組成連續世界
worldArchitecture.description: 城鎮、野外、洞穴各為獨立地圖，透過地圖出口連接。
constraints: Keep existing V0.5.43 test maps unchanged until new implementation is approved.
Monster combat and spawn states remain server authoritative.
On successful map transition, cancel queued unexecuted attacks/skills, retain already-applied effects and cooldowns.
On failed transition, restore last server-confirmed valid map and position.
Ordinary monsters do not chase players across map boundaries.

mapDimensions.name: 地圖尺寸自由設定
mapDimensions.details: Each map independently defines widthTiles and heightTiles; non-square maps supported; no fixed 64/128/256 presets required.
safeguards: Positive integer widthTiles and heightTiles validated on import.
Performance constraints via viewport culling and chunked map data for large maps.
Server validates map bounds, collisions and transition destinations.
No fixed maximum dimension approved yet; benchmark before choosing technical caps.

transitions.name: 自動區域切換與互動入口並存
rules: General roads and map boundaries can use automatic trigger regions.
Doors, staircases, dungeon entrances and teleporters may require explicit interaction.
Each portal has an explicit triggerType (auto|interact), destination mapId, destination spawn marker, and optional conditions.
Server authoritatively validates transitions and applies map and position changes atomically.
On success cancel unexecuted combat queues, retain applied effects and cooldowns; ordinary monsters do not follow across maps.
On failure restore last server-confirmed valid map and position.

dataStructure.name: 模組化分層地圖資料結構
rules: Separate map metadata, terrain, collision, portals/interactions and monster spawn configuration.
Small maps may load all modules together; chunked loading and caching may be added for large maps after profiling.
Preserve existing V0.5.43 game until replacement maps are playable and user approves migration.
Use stable custom mapId and original Taiwan NPC IDs for monster templates.

tileSizePx.reason: Logical tile size; rendering may scale independently on iPhone Safari.

mapDimensionsTiles.note: 64/128/256 are optional design examples only, not mandatory map dimensions.

schema.name: display name
schema.tileWidth: positive integer independently configured per map
schema.tileHeight: positive integer independently configured per map
schema.spawnGroups: monster npcId, count, geometry, respawn settings
schema.mapChunking: optional for large maps, implementation pending

style.name: 荒廢葡萄園
style.notes: Terrain theme only; layout and exits await review.

roadNetwork.description: 彎曲主道路連接南入口與東出口，支線通往廢棄農舍與荒廢藤架。
constraints: Road network approved conceptually; precise tile coordinates not yet approved.
Do not implement unapproved exit destinations or collision geometry.

collision.name: 混合碰撞
rules: 地形阻擋以格子旗標管理。
樹幹、岩石、建築、特殊物件可使用圓形或矩形碰撞體。
葡萄藤架主體阻擋，行間小徑可通行。
農舍牆體阻擋，門口預留互動或出入口。
完整柵欄阻擋，破損缺口可通行。
最終碰撞體尺寸與位置待實作測試核定。

exitConfiguration.description: 南、東、西三處野外自動切圖出口，另預留農舍互動入口；各目的地及座標尚未核定。

worldConnectionPlan.concept: Three existing maps connect directly without transitional maps
notes: Choice A recorded, but each specific destination and return portal is not yet formally approved.
Do not implement map transitions until destination map IDs, entry points and reciprocal links are reviewed.
2026-10-24: User prioritizes completing vineyard first, then town, then ancient battlefield, then ghoul grounds. Specific destinations not approved.

farmhouseHideoutDraft.concept: Abandoned farmhouse as bandit hideout; vineyard monsters may randomly drop a farmhouse key; key allows entry to farmhouse encounter with bandit leader.
pending: Whether original boss loot remains unchanged
farmhouseHideoutDraft.designDirection: Phase 1 shared farmhouse with one server-wide boss and key-gated entry; reserve map-template/instance separation for possible future party instances.
rulesPending: Multiple players entry, reentry, disconnect and boss respawn

keyConsumption.rule: Each player consumes exactly one farmhouse key on successful entry to shared farmhouse; failed entry must not consume key.
keyConsumption.atomicity: Server-authoritative atomic key deduction and map transfer; no double-charge on retry.

bossDeathSettlement.rule: On boss death server resolves combat and generates ground loot, immediately blocks new farmhouse entries, permits 60 seconds to pick up loot, then transfers all remaining farmhouse players to vineyard.
bossDeathSettlement.lootOwnership: Preserve existing multiplayer loot ownership/protection rules; 60-second timer is farmhouse evacuation grace period only.
bossDeathSettlement.serverAuthority: Death and loot finalized before evacuation; transition is server-authoritative.

mapRemake.strategy: Design each map with user, implement modular assets, test individually, then switch playable game without losing existing version.

workflow.priority: Finish vineyard terrain, road, collisions, monster placements, playable test; then town; then ancient battlefield; then ghoul grounds.
workflow.exitDestinations: Proposals only, not approved or implemented
